name: Gobber Delight
summary:
Gobber Delight is an add-on for Farmer's Delight that adds compatibility with Gobber.
It's recommended to play with JEI and Appleskin to view recipes and food stats in-game.

Main Features
Whole new food tier for the End in style of Gobber Mod.
Expanded Gobber and Nether Gobber food tiers.
New knives for all three sets of items.
New cutting board recipes for more efficient processing of gooey meat.
Additional alternative recipes for gooey beewstew.
Lightweight and compatible with most mods via forge tags.
